rca_of_issue: Original bug: BillsSection auto-saved the analysis file via POST /contacts/{cid}/files, but parent contact/[id].tsx state variable `c.files` was populated only on mount/focus via `load()`. Switching tabs did NOT re-fetch, so tab-files rendered from the stale in-memory copy → 'Nessun file'. Fix: (1) added optional prop onContactFilesChanged to BillsSection, (2) BillsSection invokes it after every successful POST inside saveFileToContactIfNew, (3) parent passes `load` (which re-fetches GET /contacts/{id} and setC(...)). Now the parent state is refreshed on the same session and tab-files renders the newly saved Analisi-* entry immediately.
